scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Hostel Facility in Professional/Technical Institutions (HBOCWWB)
other_conditions: The applicant must be registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
The registered worker must have at least one year of regular, active membership with the Board
Benefits are available for the children of construction workers who stay in hostels while pursuing regular technical or professional courses
Financial assistance is limited to a maximum of three children per worker
To avail the benefit, the worker must add a minimum of 90 days of work experience in the preceding year and pay the registration fee
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹1,20,000 per child for hostel facilities in recognized professional/technical institutions.
documents_required: Attested copy of the original receipt
